name: Drunkards
overview: Scripture warns strongly against the dangers of excessive drinking and the lifestyle of drunkards, portraying wine and strong drink as deceptive and destructive forces that mock and rage against wisdom (Proverbs 20:1). The Bible cautions believers to avoid becoming winebibbers and riotous eaters, as such behavior leads to poverty and disgrace (Proverbs 23:20-21). The imagery of a thorn in the hand of a drunkard illustrates the painful and harmful consequences of drunkenness (Proverbs 26:9), while Isaiah pronounces woe on those who pursue strong drink from morning until night and pride themselves on their drinking strength (Isaiah 5:11, 22). These verses collectively highlight the spiritual and practical ruin that follows a lifestyle dominated by drunkenness.
